about.title: About Clubnizer
about.description: Clubnizer is a clean and focused platform designed to help teams and clubs organize their sports activities in a simple and structured way.
about.builtFromExperienceParagraph1: Clubnizer was created from firsthand experience in youth sports. As a volunteer coach and parent involved in organizing teams, training sessions, and matches, it became clear how much time was spent managing logistics instead of focusing on the sport itself.
about.builtFromExperienceParagraph2: Many tools felt overly complex for everyday team management. Clubnizer was built to simplify the essentials — managing members, planning events, tracking attendance, and keeping communication within the team clear and organized.
about.builtFromExperienceParagraph3: The project was built with three main intentions.
about.builtFromExperienceParagraph4: The first was to make managing teams and clubs simpler, reducing administration so coaches and volunteers can spend less time on logistics and more time on the field.
about.builtFromExperienceParagraph5: The second intention was to make communication easy and intuitive for everyone involved — not only for administrators and coaches, but also for parents and guardians. Responding to events, following updates, and staying connected with the team should be quick and effortless.
about.builtFromExperienceParagraph6: The third intention was to help make sports more affordable for members. Many clubs rely on volunteers and limited budgets, and software costs can easily become another expense. To make sports more accessible for players and families, it needs to be affordable for the clubs as well.
about.builtFromExperienceParagraph7: That is why Clubnizer is designed to be free or extremely low-cost for clubs to use. The goal is simple: reduce administrative work, simplify communication, and keep software costs minimal so more people can participate in sports and more time can be spent actually playing the game.
about.continuouslyImprovingParagraph1: Clubnizer is actively evolving and continuously improving based on real-world use and feedback from teams and clubs.
about.continuouslyImprovingParagraph2: If you experience any issues, find a bug, or have suggestions for improvement, we would truly appreciate hearing from you.

lokPersonnummer.title: Personnummer for LOK-stöd
lokPersonnummer.subtitle: Your club {{clubName}} uses LOK-stöd for attendance reporting to the Swedish Sports Confederation (RF).
lokPersonnummer.whyNeededText: Swedish sports clubs receive LOK-stöd (local activity support) from Riksidrottsförbundet (RF). To report attendance, participants' personnummer is required.
lokPersonnummer.bullet1: Used only for LOK-stöd attendance reporting to RF
lokPersonnummer.bullet2: Encrypted with AES-256 — stored securely, never shown in full
lokPersonnummer.bullet3: You can remove it at any time (GDPR right to erasure)
lokPersonnummer.securityText: Your personnummer is encrypted before storage. Only the last 4 digits are used for identification in the app. The full number is only decrypted server-side when submitting reports to RF.
lokPersonnummer.replacingInfo: Enter your new personnummer below. This will replace the existing one.
lokPersonnummer.consentText: I consent to my personnummer being stored and used for LOK-stöd attendance reporting to Riksidrottsförbundet (RF).
lokPersonnummer.consentDetail: Your personnummer will be encrypted and used solely for submitting attendance reports. You can withdraw consent and delete your personnummer at any time.
lokPersonnummer.successMessage: Your personnummer has been securely encrypted and stored.
lokPersonnummer.removedMessage: Your personnummer has been permanently deleted from our systems.
lokPersonnummer.removeHelperText: This will permanently delete your personnummer. You will need to provide it again if you want to be included in future LOK-stöd reports.
lokPersonnummer.removeModalMessage: This will permanently delete your personnummer from our systems. You will not be included in future LOK-stöd reports until you provide it again.

errors.consentRequired: You must give consent before saving your personnummer.
